response.sql:
WITH per_race AS (
  SELECT raceId,
         AVG(points) AS avg_points,
         AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings
  WHERE points > 6.0
  GROUP BY raceId
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins
  FROM per_race
)
SELECT p.raceId,
       p.avg_points,
       p.avg_wins,
       p.avg_wins - o.overall_avg_wins AS wins_diff
FROM per_race p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY wins_diff IS NULL, wins_diff DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: 'Clear the 6.0-point threshold' means points strictly greater than 6.0; rows with NULL points are excluded by the comparison.

AVG ignores NULL wins values; the overall average is taken over the per-race averages that are non-NULL, and it returns no rows when that overall average is NULL. Per-race averages use the season-to-date values as stored, per the verified notes.

alternatives.interpretation: 'Clear the threshold' includes points equal to 6.0 (at least 6.0), so the filter is points >= 6.0.
